findings.quoted_text: Invoices are payable within 15 days after Client receives payment from its own customer.
Contractor shall be liable for all losses, damages, costs, and claims arising from the Services, without limitation.
Payment period: 15 days after Client is paid by its customer
Invoices are payable within 15 days after Client receives payment from its own customer.
findings.explanation: This is a "pay-if-paid" clause, meaning you might not get paid for your work until the client's customer pays them, which introduces indefinite delays outside of your control.
findings.suggested_change: Invoices are payable within 30 days after receipt of invoice.

findings.quoted_text: Contractor shall be liable for all losses, damages, costs, and claims arising from the Services, without limitation.
findings.explanation: Your liability is completely uncapped and unlimited, exposing you to potentially massive financial risk if something goes wrong.
findings.suggested_change: Contractor's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall be limited to the total fees paid to Contractor under this Agreement.

findings.quoted_text: Payment period: 15 days after Client is paid by its customer
findings.explanation: Your payment depends on an indefinite event (the client getting paid by their customer), which means you might wait a very long time or never get paid.
findings.suggested_change: Payment shall be made within 30 days of the Contractor's invoice.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, Thank you for sending over the agreement. I am looking forward to working together, but before I sign, I would like to propose a few small adjustments: - Regarding the clause stating "Invoices are payable within 15 days after Client receives payment from its own customer.", this ties payment to an outside event which introduces delays. I suggest changing this to: "Invoices are payable within 30 days after receipt of invoice." - Regarding the clause stating "Contractor shall be liable for all losses, damages, costs, and claims arising from the Services, without limitation.", this leaves liability completely uncapped. I suggest changing this to: "Contractor's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall be limited to the total fees paid to Contractor under this Agreement." - Regarding the clause stating "Payment period: 15 days after Client is paid by its customer", this makes payment dependent on an indefinite event. I suggest changing this to: "Payment shall be made within 30 days of the Contractor's invoice." Please let me know if these updates work for you so we can move forward. Best regards,
